## Active next-development plan — design gate only (2026-10-15 JST)

**Parent instrument:** #1. **Replaces the active planning route:** #242 / #253; preserves their unresolved acceptance obligations.

The owner requested reorganizing current PRs/issues around a functional-board architecture: **separate front jack and pot/control PCBs, a local middle interconnect zone, and a rear functional circuit card**. Start with one complete OSC zone and adjacent O1/O2 fit. This is the preferred candidate to study, not a validated or adopted architecture.

## Fixed scope and proposed boundary

Retain all five oscillators O1–O5, all 33 instrument functions and 438 locked panel centres. One OSC keeps four inputs (1V/OCT, FM, PWM, SYNC), four outputs (SIN/TRI/SAW/PUL), eight controls (OCT, RANGE, SYNC mode, TUNE, FINE, FM depth, PW, PWM depth), six calibration trimmers, and all protection/processing. Shared octave span remains separately accounted.

- **Front jack PCB:** raw-jack protection and input buffering; output drivers, protection and their local feedback.
- **Separate front pot/control PCB:** controls and their required processing. Classify each permitted wiper explicitly; do not assume every wiper is buffered.
- **Middle OSC zone:** local point-to-point correspondence among front boards, octave assembly and rear card. Share only required power/reference services; no five-OSC audio/CV bus, new mux, or hidden signal normals. A logical zone does not imply a separate PCB or a ground-plane slit.
- **Rear OSC card:** oscillator, pitch summing, timing/compensation, shaping, PWM/sync local circuitry, VEE5, local reference buffers, six trimmers and suitable measurement access.
- Keep TIMING_CAP, EXPO_SUM, compensation/high-frequency correction, VEE5/local feedback and unshaped internal waveforms local. No distant output-feedback loop or unprotected core-to-rear-jack connection.

Repeat one electrical rear-card design where feasible; identical mechanical cartridges/connectors are not yet demonstrated. Compare the functional candidate with a limited-change core-only-card control, using identical functionality and fixed panel geometry.

## Sequence and decision gates

1. Freeze an exact read-only source/reuse/status ledger and complete O1 net/interface/rear-terminal inventory.
2. Develop one-zone mechanics plus end-to-end power/ground/reference allocations in parallel against that contract.
3. Verify adjacent O1/O2 fit and service access; reconcile connector positions with electrical paths.
4. Produce an independently reviewed go/revise/stop decision and bounded implementation handoff. Owner approval is required before implementation/native execution. **Do not route a whole-instrument motherboard before representative one-zone and adjacent-two feasibility are demonstrated.**
5. Only in separately authorized later work: implement and completely verify one zone; fabricate/test one complete unit, an independently assembled second, then all five and the full instrument. Design review, model passes and one-unit success cannot substitute for physical qualification.

## Linked design backlog

- [ ] #279 — source baseline and reuse/requirement ledger (start here)
- [ ] #280 — complete O1 interface/package ownership and existing rear-terminal inventory (after #279)
- [ ] #281 — one-zone stack/support/rear-service geometry (after #280; coordinate with #282)
- [ ] #282 — end-to-end power/AGND/reference allocations (after #280; coordinate with #281)
- [ ] #283 — adjacent O1/O2 fit and complete connection/assembly comparison (after #281/#282)
- [ ] #284 — independent decision gate and staged verification/implementation handoff (after all five)

Dependency links are maintained in these bodies; no native GitHub sub-issue relationships are claimed. All six are **planned, not executing**. Readiness means a reviewed revision-bound deliverable, not simply an issue being closed.

## Current baseline and retained evidence

Refreshed 2026-10-14 UTC:
- Default/final delivery branch `main`: `65cefd41fc39e064d38319115ad96016a1c6b71c`.
- Parked integration PR #260 / `integration/epic-242-core-routing`: `5af0e7b675123b40367078ee605a1355bae49a62`, draft/unmerged.
- Final stopped E16 PR #277: `fdac23b2611dcb26f840c520348771821ea9c35d`. [Owner pause](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/issues/242#issuecomment-6177014583), [immutable checkpoint](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/blob/fdac23b2611dcb26f840c520348771821ea9c35d/design/partition/core-split/candidates/planning/joined-feed-construction-v2/WORK.md#e16-current-checkpoint).
- KEEP_K1402_INCUMBENT. Canonical boards/copper, locked placement, circuit intent and decision.json are preserved. New architecture is not adopted.
- E16 usage 16/24 diagnostics, 2/3 baselines; metadata guard PASS and cleanup complete do not establish numerical qualification. Full resource qualification NOT_QUALIFIED; production NOT_ADMITTED/NOT_RUN; selected Stage C NOT RUN. Remaining budget is not restart permission.
- Finite-path coverage and classification of 552 old omissions were already completed. Do not reopen them as new discovery work. Preserve failed copper-resistance, incomplete load/GH accounting and other acceptance defects. Reduced-load results are not full acceptance.

## Existing work disposition

| Existing work | Disposition in this plan |
| --- | --- |
| #242 and #243–247, #250–259 | Park old execution topology; retain evidence, negative results and unmet requirements. No automatic restart from historical prompts. |
| #248 / #249 and PR #261 / #267 | Reuse candidates for component identity, trimmer semantics and source-owned labels; rebind to the new design before adoption. |
| PR #260 | Preserve integration lineage, draft/unmerged; not the implementation branch for the new architecture by default. |
| PR #274–277 | Park E16 diagnostic/reconstruction stack; retain every source/review/artifact and admission limitation. |
| PR #262/#264/#265/#270/#271 | Historical split/power/mechanical evidence; reuse constraints and failures, not new-board fit or power acceptance. |
| PR #266/#268/#269 | Retain JR/JL/K endpoint and rejected-pilot evidence; no routing restart. |
| PR #221/#225/#226/#229/#233/#236–241 | Preserve prior native/rejection/audit lineage as open drafts; no blanket adoption or closure. |
| #189/#38/#39/#43 | Open electrical/CAD delivery obligations; map applicability rather than calling complete. |
| #21/#29–31/#55/#57/#59/#64/#65/#214 and broader #1/#44/#45 | Open component, physical, protection, source, toolchain and whole-instrument gates remain owned by their existing issues. |

No existing open issue is closed solely because this planning direction changed. These are incomplete deliverables or evidence lineage, not proven duplicate completed work.

## Evidence sources (immutable, refresh changed inputs before using)

[Functional contract](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/blob/011e8be351e81d51a13d2d56cb246fd36d623843/project/osc-hole-field/block-contracts.json), [connector inventory](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/blob/011e8be351e81d51a13d2d56cb246fd36d623843/design/reports/connectors.json), [board stack](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/blob/011e8be351e81d51a13d2d56cb246fd36d623843/doc/src/content/docs/architecture/osc-board-stack.mdx), [I/O boundaries](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/blob/011e8be351e81d51a13d2d56cb246fd36d623843/doc/src/content/docs/architecture/osc-io-partition.mdx), [OSC circuit](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/blob/011e8be351e81d51a13d2d56cb246fd36d623843/doc/src/content/docs/architecture/osc-block-osc.mdx), [electrical standard](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/blob/011e8be351e81d51a13d2d56cb246fd36d623843/doc/src/content/docs/architecture/osc-electrical-standard.mdx), [reference fanout](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/blob/011e8be351e81d51a13d2d56cb246fd36d623843/doc/src/content/docs/architecture/osc-reference-fanout.mdx), [octave reference](https://github.com/Takazudo/zudo-osc-hole-field/blob/011e8be351e81d51a13d2d56cb246fd36d623843/doc/src/content/docs/architecture/osc-octave-reference.mdx).

## Authorization and done condition

This organization request permits issue/PR planning metadata, not code/CAD edits, worker/native campaigns, merges, branch deletion, fabrication/order files, purchases, supplier outreach or energization. Historical authorization blocks below linked old issues do not dispatch work. New task issues specify future design deliverables; creating them does not start execution.

This epic is complete only when its linked design deliverables and independent review support a documented decision, unresolved assumptions are explicit, and a separately approvable implementation scope exists. Electrical/manufacturing acceptance issues remain open.
